column1: # The lightweight HPS-to-FPGA bridge (and f2h_irq0[0..3]) at the fabric: per port bit of the
# HPS atom, the routing-graph node it meets. in = fabric drives the HPS (the RPII sink, as the
# irq lines); out = the HPS drives the fabric (the SOC_HPS_WRAPPER_RE source). LWSOC2FPGA_CLK
# is the bridge clock, a sink of a global clock. From Quartus 26.1.1 route dumps
# (tools/hps_routes.tcl) of designs/hpsf and a variant using every bit; both agree.
